newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner welcomes talks between Krupp and Thyssen.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner welcomes talks between Krupp and Thyssen.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG on Tuesday welcomed Fried. Krupp AG's proposal to enter cooperation talks with Thyssen AG after initially launching a 13.6 billion mark takeover for the firm.
"We would have welcomed it if the various talks on the subject had led to a mutual solution in the past," a spokesman said in answer to Reuter enquiries.
"We therefore see the developments triggered by the Krupp proposal as positive," he added.
Dresdner Bank's investment banking unit Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, together with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and Goldman Sachs is financing Krupp's bid.
